args.text: [lane-ibis] Risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Users are sent to old or dead servers after a site moves or fails over, so outages last longer. (2) Changes such as new security settings or certificate-related records spread slowly, delaying fixes. (3) A poisoned or wrong answer stays stored for longer, so harm from it lasts longer.

[lane-ibis] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail in ways that leave the sender unsure whether a request worked, and an idempotent request can be safely sent again without changing the result more than once. This prevents harm such as double payments or duplicate orders while still letting systems recover from temporary faults.
